title: Shipment Volume Rate in the Home Delivery Pharmacy Settlement Courtesy
content:
## Member loyalty terms: shipment volume

**Term.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy member who settles the past-due amount in full, a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is a shipment-volume rate: for 8 or more shipped orders (replacement shipments are not counted) dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date it is figured per order, half a percent (0.5 percent) for each such order; for 4 to 7 such orders it is a flat 2 percent; and fewer orders earn nothing. The courtesy rates are added together and applied once to the past-due amount, and only that result is rounded to the nearest cent.

Shipped orders are the account's shipment records; replacement shipments are a different record and are not counted.

### Method by volume

| Shipped orders dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date | Shipment-volume rate |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 0.5 percent for each order |
| 4 to 7 | a flat 2 percent |
| 3 or fewer | nothing |

### Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Shipped orders | Rate |
|---|---|
| 12 | 0.5 percent times 12, 6 percent |
| 8 | 0.5 percent times 8, 4 percent |
| 7 | 2 percent |
| 4 | 2 percent |
| 3 | nothing |

On a past-due amount of 200.00 with only this rate at 4 percent, 8.00 comes off, leaving 192.00.
